skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it.

Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius, applies False Intelligence on the target for 2 turns, Dampness on the target for 1 turn and deals Turbid damage equivalent to 130% ATK to it. Increases Contamination Gauge by 1 point for self.

Selects an ally within a 9 tile radius, restores their HP equivalent to 100% ATK and 3 Stability, and applies Overflowing Care for 2 rounds (Buff expires at the end of the current round/start of the next round). Increases Contamination Gauge by 1 point for self.

Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius, summons Taryz that follows the target for 2 rounds (Expires at the end of the current round), applies Dampness and False Intelligence on the target and all enemies within a 3 tile radius of the target for 2 turns, and deals AoE Turbid damage equivalent to 80% ATK.
Applies Buried Bonds and Overflowing Care for all allies for 2 rounds (Buff expires at the end of the current round), restores HP equivalent to 100% ATK and 2 Stability, dispels 1 debuff, and dispels Taunt and Panic.
When the target that Taryz is following dies, it automatically follows the enemy unit with the highest HP next. Increases Contamination Gauge by 2 points for self.

If Contamination Gauge is at maximum after attacking, decreases Contamination Gauge to 0 points, and gains an instance of Additional Action.
At the start of the turn, if Springfield's HP is above 80%, gains Insight for 2 turns. If the target that Taryz is following deals damage to an ally, activates Counter, dealing Turbid damage equivalent to 20% of Springfield's max HP and 1 Stability damage, and restores HP for the ally equivalent to 20% of Springfield's max HP. This effect can be activated twice per round.
If Taryz is on the field, at the end of Springfield's action, restores HP equivalent to 20% max HP.
